As he exited their cell, Lloyd responded to his teammates' groans by pointing out that being put to work could be an opportunity to prove that they were not going to cause any further trouble. Lloyd also reminded his friends not to use their powers to assist in whatever work they were to be assigned before all five ninja were herded onto a prison bus. After taking a seat in the back of the bus, Lloyd and the others learned that they would be cleaning up litter from Route 22.

As the bus traveled alongside the Sea of Sand and briefly stopped for the guards to assist an elderly man with a broken engine, Lloyd and the others moved to the front of their section to watch the ongoing situation. Seconds later, Nya landed behind the prison bus in her new Samurai X Mech and tore open the backdoor, allowing for Lloyd and the other ninja to escape. The elderly man then drove his van over to where the ninja were hiding and gestured for them to board, taking off at high speed and leaving the guards behind!

After driving for some time, the man pulled off his hat and fake beard, revealing his identity as none other than Dareth, who explained that this was the last resort he had in mind for getting the ninja out of prison. Dareth's evoked a horrified look from Lloyd, but he did not have much more time to dwell on matters, for a police cruiser had activated its sirens and was now pursuing Dareth's van! After shaking off the police cruiser, Dareth's engine actually gave out, forcing Lloyd and the others to put on the new uniforms provided by P.I.X.A.L. and traverse the desert on foot. By nightfall, with the Ninjago Police combing the desert in search of the ninja, Lloyd was forced to make a difficult decision. Fearing that they would soon be caught again should they stick together, Lloyd split the ninja up into two groups: he would go alongside Jay, Cole, and Fugidove in one direction while Kai, Zane, and Dareth would go the other. Their objective was to find Twitchy Tim's gas station to ask their old ally for his assistance. When Cole asked what would they do should one group fail to arrive by noon the next day, Lloyd reluctantly admitted that they would have to assume the late group had been captured and move on without them. With no further questions, Lloyd and his group began wandering further into the desert.

The Fifth Villain[]

Continuing to wander across the Sea of Sand with his team, Lloyd paid no mind to Jay's increasing aggravation with Fugi-Dove, though he would on occasion poke fun at Jay's expense. Eventually, the group discovered a highway in the Sea of Sand and realized that they were close to Twitchy Tim's gas station. At this point, Fugi-Dove decided to give Jay his first lesson in crime and produced a bottle of water, which he then emptied onto the parched sands before dropping the bottle onto the ground, declaring that he had successfully committed the crime of petty vandalism! Once more, Lloyd paid no attention to Fugi-Dove's antics until the former expressed his hope that such actions would grant him a seat on the Crystal Council. Being alerted to the words "crystal" and "council," Lloyd pressed Fugi-Dove for more details and then decided that the ninja would have to capture and replace the next likely candidate to be invited to said council.

Eventually, Lloyd and his group arrived at Twitchy Tim's gas station, where they were warmly greeted by the namesake proprietor. Upon hearing Twitchy say his name, Lloyd smiled warmly and remarked with surprise that Twitchy remembered his and the other ninja's names. He then listened on to Twitchy's explanation that he now practiced ways to remember things before entering the store to enjoy a cool and refreshing drink of water. In the gas station, Lloyd relayed to Kai and Zane his plan of deducing the next likeliest candidate to be invited into the Council of the Crystal King and impersonating them to infiltrate the council. In the ensuing discussion, Lloyd shot down suggestions of Killow, Ultra Violet, or Captain Soto being the next likely invitee, dismissing them all as being small time criminals and urging for the ninja to think bigger. When the ninja finally settled on the Mechanic as possibly being the next invitee, Lloyd suggested that it would be worth paying him a visit, for they already knew the location of his secret lair in Ninjago City. As the the ninja prepared to leave, Hounddog McBrag and his squadron pulled up outside and ordered for the ninja to surrender, prompting for Lloyd and the others to dive behind the gas station counter for cover. Unfortunately, when the police entered the store to search for the ninja, Twitchy almost immediately gave away the ninja's hiding spot, much to Lloyd's chagrin. Fortunately, Fugi-Dove revealed himself and attacked the officers to take attention away from the ninja just long enough for them to escape outside. Taking one of the police SUVs, the ninja climbed aboard and sped off to Ninjago City.

Night had fallen by the time the ninja returned to Ninjago City and investigated the lair of the Mechanic. Although the derelict arcade seemed devoid of any sign of the once small time crook, the presence of many robo arms suggested his lingering presence. As Lloyd inspected one of these robo-arms, the Mechanic revealed himself and ambushed Lloyd, attacking him with the lair's many mechanical arms. After being freed by Jay, Lloyd called for his allies to attack the Mechanic, declaring that they could not let him escape. This comment confused the villain, who shot back that he was not running away from his home, but was rather defending it from the ninja, grappling Lloyd with another mechanical arm and flinging him halfway across the lair all the while. Eventually, Lloyd ended the fight with the Mechanic by taking advantage of a temporary distraction and tipping over an arcade cabinet on top of him. As the Mechanic lay pinned underneath the cabinet and struggled to escape, Lloyd activated his power of Energy and held his glowing hand slightly above the Mechanic's head in a threatening manner to keep him restrained.

Once the Mechanic was defeated and restrained, Lloyd disguised himself as the Mechanic, putting on a set of the crook's clothing and even one of his robo-arms before taking position at the lair's workbench to await the arrival of the Crystal Spiders. And as if on cue, the spiders came just in time to recruit "the Mechanic," with Lloyd following them back to the Council of the Crystal King.

The Council of the Crystal King[]

Within the depths of the Ninjago Metro, Lloyd hastily followed the Crystal Spider, attempting to make conversation with it as he ran. Eventually, the spider led Lloyd back to the abandoned N Line and activated a secret mechanism hidden against the wall that marked the end of the path. Watching in awe as a secret door revealed itself, Lloyd muttered that Jay had been right after all and hastily leapt through the closing door. After ascending a long stairwell, Lloyd discovered a shuttle waiting there for him. Without further prompting, Lloyd stepped in and sped off with lightning speed to parts unknown.

Eventually, the shuttle began to slow its approach and Lloyd could make out the surrounding walls covered in pink crystals - clearly indication that he was nearing the Lair of the Council of the Crystal King. As he tumbled out of the shuttle, Lloyd crashed into a statue carved from vengestone, setting off a chain reaction that toppled over an entire row of them. After sheepishly apologizing, Lloyd was greeted by another Crystal Spider, which beckoned for him to follow it to the top of another flight of stairs. Although he would start off running, Lloyd soon found himself halting in his tracks as he encountered a large table and seated around it, were all the villains who had previously been recruited by the Crystal King! Scanning the room, Lloyd saw Pythor, Aspheera, Vangelis, and even MR. E?! Pythor would correct Lloyd in the moment, revealing that this Nindroid was actually a new model named Mister F, though he lamented that the droid still was incapable of speech.

Vangelis then questioned Lloyd, inquiring about his identity, to which Lloyd introduced himself as being the Mechanic and that his claim to fame was for being the one who unleashed Unagami into Ninjago City. Taking a seat beside Aspheera, Lloyd then pointed out the vacant chair at the head of the table and asked if the others knew who sat upon it. Although the others surmised that the Crystal King himself would sit at the head of the table, the Kabuki Mask appeared from behind and corrected the group, stating that was actually his seat. The Kabuki Mask then revealed his position as the Crystal King's herald, and cautioned the Council that an imposter currently lay in their midst. Before the Kabuki Mask could continue, Aspheera interjected to demand for the imposter to reveal their identity, casting a suspicious glance at Lloyd who deflected attention away by repeating Aspheera's question. Unfortunately, this would only buy Lloyd a few more seconds, for the Kabuki Mask proceeded to play a recording collected by one of the Crystal Spiders, showing the ninja in combat with the real Mechanic just moments prior.

As all eyes turned to Lloyd, he declared that the villains had forgotten about one thing. When they asked what it was, Lloyd pointed towards the wall behind them and rushed out of his seat towards the exit as they turned to look. This distraction, however, lasted even shorter than his previous diversion and Pythor shouted for the rest of the Council to capture Lloyd. Aspheera immediately flew into action and fired a bolt of magic at him, though Lloyd dodged it and shot out a fireball from the robo-arm he was wearing, nearly striking Pythor with it. The cunning Anacondrai though used this opportunity to turn invisible and swiftly sneak up on Lloyd from behind, seizing ahold of him and hoisting him into the air. Lloyd then retaliated with Spinjitzu, knocking Pythor, Mister F, and Vangelis all to the side as Aspheera fruitlessly attempted to strike with her naginata. It would be Mister F who ultimately would defeat Lloyd, taking aim with his Crystal gun to strike and rip Lloyd out from his Spinjitzu tornado.

As Lloyd now slumped against one of the chamber's pillars, fading in and out of consciousness, he watched through dimming eyes as the Council gathered around him and the Kabuki Mask approached, mocking his efforts. As the masked herald stepped closer, he stated that he would give a Lloyd a clue towards his identity and began to sing a familiar song as he reached up to remove his mask. Lloyd, of course, recognized the song and felt a shiver of dread as the herald's mask fell, uncovering long strands of white hair and "his" disguised voice changed into one that Lloyd was all too familiar with. "No...it can't be!" he muttered under his breath. Right before as his lights faded the last thing Lloyd saw was the mocking grin of Harumi, the princess whom he had long believed to be dead.

A Sinister Shadow[]

Shackled before the Central crystal, Lloyd listened on as Harumi revealed to him the full extent of her planning and plotting for the rise of the Crystal King, starting with her death and resurrection by the King. Once she finished telling her tale, twirling the key to Lloyd's shackles before his eyes, Lloyd thought up of a plan and feigned ignorance in an attempt to provoke Harumi into divulging more details about her plans and to get close enough to him so that he could discreetly snatch the key. After learning that Harumi's next move was to attack the Monastery of Spinjitzu for the powerless Golden Weapons, Lloyd finally confessed that his feelings for Harumi were real, provoking her enough into stepping closer to him.

While Lloyd then admitted to her that he did search the rubble for her body later on that fateful day of her death, he secretly relieved the keyring from Harumi's waist as she leaned in closer to him with a nasty glare. When the fallen princess began sulking away, Lloyd freed himself and declared his intention of stopping her from stealing the Golden Weapons. In response to Lloyd's actions, Harumi called upon Mister F to deal with him. As the Nindroid approached, Lloyd immediately attempted to respond with a blast of Energy, only to discover in shock that he could not call upon his elemental power. Mister F seized this moment of distraction to then kick Lloyd to the ground and secure him once more. With Lloyd subdued, Harumi stepped towards him and gloated that in the presence of all the Vengestone found in the Crystal Temple, Lloyd was all but powerless to stop the coming of the Crystal King. As if on cue, the central crystal began to glow as evil laughter emanated from its surface, turning Lloyd's attention towards it.

The Spider's Design[]

Awakening, Lloyd found himself trapped within a Vengestone cage suspended over a pool of lava. After examining his surroundings and noting that Mister F's back was turned to him, Lloyd attempted to free himself from the cage with his powers, but to no avail. At that moment, Harumi entered the room and began gloating to Lloyd about his helpless situation. Ignoring her cutting comments, Lloyd attempted to reason with her, appealing first to her humanity by acknowledging her anger towards him but reminding her that she did not want innocents to be caught in the crossfire. Harumi, however, ignored Lloyd's statements and instead suggested that he was like her as well, hiding the evil within him beneath a mask of heroism. When Lloyd denied Harumi's suggestion, she cheerfully reminded him of his heritage and how he too was part Oni, just like his father Garmadon.

At that moment, the room's computer picked up surveillance footage of the ninja's investigation of the Ninjago Metro. Believing his friends would soon close in on the Crystal Temple, Lloyd urged Harumi to stand down, warning that she would soon be defeated. Unfortunately, Harumi revealed that she had backup plans already in motion and activated a horde of Crystal Spiders, much to Lloyd's horror. As the spiders began closing in on the ninja, Lloyd became increasingly frantic, rattling against the bars of his cage and pleading with Harumi to spare his friend's lives. Of course, Harumi ignored Lloyd's pleas and relished in the pain she was causing him as she activated the spiders' detonators.

With his friends seemingly killed, Lloyd sank to his knees and growled under his breath, anger building up within every ounce of his body. In fury, he shouted towards Harumi that he, Wu, P.I.X.A.L., and all who were left would resist her and the Crystal King with every breath they had left! In response, Harumi smugly replied that she had plans to deal with them next as well, tipping Lloyd's anger to reach its boiling point. As if suddenly possessed by an outside force, Lloyd's eyes turned a sinister shade of purple as he tapped into his dormant power of Destruction and shattered open the Vengestone cage that once held him. Although Mister F sprang into action, Lloyd swiftly kicked the nindroid to the side and lunged at Harumi, intending to kill. After hurling the broken cage door at her, Lloyd continued his assault with a flurry of strikes that quickly evolved into blasts of Destruction. After disarming Harumi and knocking her to the ground, Lloyd stepped up to his former love interest and prepared to finish her once and for all. However, something within Lloyd caught him in this moment and he hesitated. Regaining control over his rage, Lloyd stepped away from Harumi but was shot in the back by a recovered Mister F, knocking him out cold.

Darkness Within[]

Lloyd awoke to discover himself suspended from the ceiling before the Central Crystal. He would have little time to struggle or even to make sense of his predicament, for shortly after, the Council of the Crystal King entered the chamber carrying the Golden Weapons. Shocked by the sight of the weapons, Lloyd angrily demanded to know where the villains obtained them and Harumi replied with the obvious - from the Monastery. When Lloyd tried to protest that Wu wouldn't simply hand over the weapons, Harumi confirmed Lloyd's greatest fears and stated matter-of-factly that he and the others at the Monastery were all dead by now. Lloyd refused to accept this response, screaming that Harumi was lying to him before swearing vengeance upon her for her actions. Nevertheless, Harumi was nonplussed by Lloyd's threats and dismissively spun him around his chain before focusing her attention on preparing the ritual to bring forth the Crystal King.

As Harumi finished up the ritual's preparations, Lloyd attempted to appeal to her good side, insisting that she could walk away from the dark path she was going down though Harumi dismissed Lloyd's words. With his appeals ignored, Lloyd could do nothing more than watch on in horror as a grotesque being emerged from the central crystal and began to laugh. As Lloyd listened to the horrible, guttural voice of the Crystal King, he felt as if though something about the being was all too familiar, though he desperately wished it was not so. The Crystal King then turned to Lloyd and spoke with a deep, raspy tone as he rhetorically asked Lloyd what the green ninja had once said to him the last time they fought, confirming Lloyd's fears. In a voice barely above a whisper, Lloyd could only fearfully whimper the true name of the Crystal King: Overlord.

The Coming of the King[]

As the Crystal King continued to laugh before him, Lloyd muttered to himself about his continued disbelief over the Overlord's return. After being addressed again by his old foe, Lloyd engaged in a brief verbal spat with him as the Crystal King demonstrated his power to an unimpressed Lloyd. After mocking the King's display, Lloyd declined his offer to join the Council with a metaphor that he sometimes liked to order off the menu rather than the presented choices. While this choice of words confused the ancient evil that was the Crystal King, Lloyd took advantage of the situation to swing himself into the King, pressing hard into his chest to propel himself back into Vangelis and kicking the corrupted Scythe of Destruction from the former Skull Sorcerer's hands. While the Crystal King and his Council watched in disbelief over what they had witnessed, Lloyd broke free from his chains and snidely "thanked" his hosts before fleeing through the halls of the temple.

As he ran through the maze like corridors of the Crystal Temple, Lloyd managed to fight off Aspheera while evading Mister F and Vangelis. Not long after though, he found himself ambushed by Pythor, giving the rest of the Council enough time to catch up and surround him. Unable to fight off five villains simultaneously, Lloyd tried to make them see reason, warning that the Crystal King would inevitably betray them all once he no longer had use for them. Unfortunately, Lloyd's warning fell on deaf ears and the Council hurled the Weapons of Destruction at him. As the crystallized and corrupted weapons drew closer, Lloyd leapt over them as they collided and released a burst of energy, knocking the grounded villains off their feet. With his foes incapacitated, Lloyd took off again in search of the exit.

Nearing the gates, Lloyd was attacked by one of the newly animated Vengestone Guards, which pursued him out of the temple. Exiting, however, was easier said than done for the Crystal Temple had been transformed into a floating island and was now drifting hundreds of feet into the air. To make matters worse, neither Lloyd nor the Guard foresaw a slope in the entrance and both were rapidly sliding out of control! Fortunately, Lloyd managed to grasp ahold of one of the gate's stone teeth and pulled himself up from the edge while the Guard was not so fortunate. Lloyd's brief moment of respite would be interrupted by Harumi and the rest of the Council mere seconds later. In spite of initially warning Harumi to stay away from him, Lloyd grabbed her arm and leapt off the Crystal Island with her, holding her tight as the two plummeted into a river below. Seeing that Harumi had fainted from the fall, Lloyd helped carry her to the surface and set her atop a large branch just above the water. Just in case, though, Lloyd relieved her of her katana and took it for himself before ferrying her back to dry land.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Traversing through the dense jungle of Primeval's Eye, Lloyd forced Harumi to walk ahead of him, occasionally moving ahead to clear the underbrush that blocked their path forward. As they walked, Harumi made several attempts to lower Lloyd's guard, though he saw through her for the most part. Unfortunately, Lloyd still chose anyway to talk back to Harumi, and one such instance distracted him just long enough for her to discreetly pull back a broad leafed plant to smack Lloyd away. As Harumi retrieved her katana and fled into the jungle, Lloyd gave chase but slipped and fell down a long sliding slope before falling into the same pit of quicksand that she had.

Thinking of a way to escape, Lloyd asked for Harumi to give him her katana, pointing out that her only options were to either trust him to save her life, or sink further into the quicksand. Harumi reluctantly complied, and Lloyd proceeded to slice off several vines to free himself then Harumi. This time however, he refused to take further chances and cut some extra vines to serve as restraints. Although Harumi at first seemingly was willing to comply, she was just as treacherous as ever, attacking Lloyd yet again when he trusted her to give in to Lloyd's requests. After a few minutes of struggle, Lloyd lost his patience and knocked Harumi to the ground with Spinjitzu.

After helping her to her feet, Lloyd tied Harumi's arms together with the extra vines and angrily stated his opinion of her. At that moment, the Council of the Crystal King flew by overhead on their Dragonides, forcing Lloyd to pull Harumi back into the trees in an effort to avoid detection. As to be expected, Harumi attacked Lloyd and shouted out towards her allies for help. Although Lloyd attempted to escape with Harumi, he soon found himself surrounded and was forced to abandon her to flee from the Council of the Crystal King. Lloyd ran through the jungle, turning at random in an effort to lose his pursuers, but soon found himself facing an insurmountable ravine. Corned, Lloyd glared at Harumi as she boasted about his predicament, though a loud roaring sound from behind caught his attention. To Lloyd's surprise and joy, he saw the Destiny's Bounty rise up from the ravine behind him and steering the magnificent ship was none other than Master Wu himself!

With his hope restored, Lloyd leapt onboard the flying ship, being helped up by Nya whom he was glad to see. The reunion however, had to be cut short, for the Council of the Crystal King began their attack on the ship and Lloyd retreated below decks. Once the Council were driven off, Lloyd returned to the deck where he, Nya, and Wu watched as the Crystal Island drifted across the horizon. Noticing his friends' puzzled looks, Lloyd explained that the Overlord had returned. He then walked towards the side of the ship and looked down towards Harumi with a defiant glare, which she returned with a cunning smile as both departed and went retreated to regroup with their respective allies.

Crystastrophe[]

Watching from aboard Destiny's Bounty, Lloyd warned that the Ninja fighting on the ground were unlikely to achieve victory against the Crystal Warriors, specifically adding that the Overlord commanded a seemingly unlimited supply of the stone soldiers. Lloyd then listened on as Wu revealed that the Overlord could not truly be destroyed, though he had apparently been receiving newspaper clippings for some time now that forewarned of the Overlord's return.

Believing that whomever sent the clippings might know of a way to defeat the Overlord, Lloyd and Nya immediately began working to uncover the identity of the mysterious mailer, eventually tracking the address to Vinny Folson of NGTV News?! In spite of Lloyd's confusion and misgivings, he and Wu decided to check out the source anyway, making their way to his apartment in Ninjago City. After knocking on the door and waiting, the pair were surprised to see that it was Garmadon who answered the door.

Christofern[]

Surprised to see his father residing at Vinny's apartment, Lloyd's surprise quickly turned into anger when the former broke the silence with "hm." Inviting himself and Wu into the apartment, Lloyd looked around with continued befuddlement, eventually expressing his confusion by emphasizing that Garmadon's presence in Ninjago City made no sense. In response to Lloyd's comments, Garmadon began to retell his guests about the events that had led him to this moment, though Lloyd continuously interrupted Garmadon's story to object to various points.

When Garmadon claimed to have changed thanks to being charged with the care of a potted plant, Lloyd bitterly expressed his doubts and urged Wu not to believe his father either. Lloyd then changed the subject back towards the newspaper clippings, but when Garmadon explained his reasonings for not taking any further action, Lloyd declared they didn't need his help and began to storm off.

Before he could leave however, a sudden crash turned Lloyd and Wu's attention as they saw now that the Crystal Army had attacked the apartment and damaged Christofern. The two watched in amazement as Garmadon transformed into his Oni form and began to lay waste upon the Crystal Warriors below. With Garmadon's powers over Destruction being strong enough to destroy the seemingly undestroyable Crystal Warriors, Wu theorized that Lloyd might need to unleash his Oni form as well in order to defeat this newest threat.

A Lesson in Anger[]

Lloyd stood beside Wu in the Samurai X Cave as the latter explained to the original four ninja about Garmadon's Oni form. When Wu added that Lloyd too was part Oni, Lloyd glanced to the side with a dispassionate expression. When Kai asked him on his thoughts about Oni form, Lloyd dismissed the possibility of achieving the technique on his own, but conceded to its efficiency against the Crystal Warriors. Nevertheless, with the fate of Ninjago at stake, Lloyd reluctantly agreed to be trained by his father in the ways of Oni form.

Some time later, in spite of following each and every one of his father's instructions to the letter, Lloyd was no closer to achieving Oni form than when he first started. To add further insult to injury, Garmadon was loudly voicing his disappointment in Lloyd's failures to achieve the technique. With each one of his father's demeaning and aggravating comments, Lloyd felt his anger and frustration slowly building up and reaching a breaking point - ironically the exact mindset Garmadon was attempting to achieve in Lloyd. Unaware of his father's true intentions, Lloyd continued to show disdain for his training in Oni form, even going as far as being more receptive to the mere prospective idea of there being a Dragon Form if it meant finishing his training as soon as possible.

After some further training, which produced just as much results as the last several hours, Garmadon continued to belittle Lloyd over his failure. This time, Garmadon struck a particular nerve by suggesting that Harumi would have been a better student than Lloyd, angering him enough into unwittingly tapping into his latent powers over Destruction, signaling the first signs of success at unleashing Oni form. To Garmadon's despair, however, Lloyd freaked out upon seeing his fists glowing with purple energy and struggled to reassert control over his anger. Needing to refuel his son's anger, Garmadon began insulting Wu when the latter returned to the Samurai X Cave, hoping that such comments would push Lloyd to the boiling point and awaken his Oni form. Instead, Lloyd simply responded with a normal amount of anger, snapping that inviting Garmadon to the Samurai X Cave had been a mistake. Before things could further heat up, Zane broke up the tension between Lloyd and his father, warning both parties that infighting would only serve to support their enemies.

P.I.X.A.L. then revealed that she had made new upgrades to the ninja's vehicles, upgrades that should allow for them to combat and destroy the Crystal Warriors. Delighted by the news, Lloyd declared that he had given Oni form "a chance," but clearly a new solution was needed to save Ninjago. While the original four ninja rushed to their vehicles to challenge the Crystal Army head on, Lloyd stayed behind to make preparations for assisting in the coming assault.

Brave But Foolish[]

Lloyd followed the original four ninja onboard Destiny's Bounty and briefly monitored the original four ninja's vehicles' status alongside Nya. Alarmed by their excessive usage, Nya warned them that they would need to shut off their new energy weapons lest they burn out their vehicles' engines, and Lloyd further emphasized her point. As the ninja complied, Wu stepped into the cabin wearing the golden dragon armor, which Lloyd took note of. However, Garmadon's dismissive comments about their odds of winning placed Lloyd in a sour mood and he stormed off to the ship's deck to get away from his father.

As the Bounty neared the Crystal Island and attempted to tow it out from the city, the Crystal King unleashed his horde of Dragonides upon them. Lloyd then did his best to fight back against the crystalline monsters, notably deflecting their energy blasts with his sword and attacking one by leaping onto its snout before knocking it back with Spinjitzu. As Harumi flew by atop a Dragonide and attacked the Bounty, Lloyd tried to plead with her to stop the Crystal King's advances, though his words fell upon deaf ears.

As he continued to fight back against the Dragonides, Lloyd gasped when he saw Wu fall in battle against the Crystal King. Watching with desperate eyes, Lloyd hoped under his breath that his falling master would recover in time and cheered when Wu activated his armor's new wing pack to glide to safety. Unfortunately for Lloyd, his celebration was too premature, for the Crystal King now attacked the Bounty with a massive bolt of Darkness. As the ship began rapidly losing altitude from its damages, Lloyd rushed to the steering wheel and pulled the airbrakes under Nya's orders. Although this managed to briefly halt their fall, the sudden stop, precipitated by the heavy damages, only served to snap the ship in half. Now thrown off balance, both halves of the ship began falling to the ground, trapping Lloyd and Garmadon on the backside as they landed hard somewhere else in the city.

Return of the Ice Emperor[]

As the Destiny's Bounty crashed into the streets of Ninjago City, Lloyd managed to survive the impact but remained buried beneath a mound of debris. After groaning as he tried to free himself, Garmadon tore through the rubble and uncovered Lloyd's body. After confirming that he was not injured, Lloyd refused his father's offer of help and instead lambasted him for not providing enough aid during their earlier battle with the Crystal King. When Garmadon repeated his belief that they would have failed anyway and that Lloyd needed to master his Oni form to defeat the Crystal King, Lloyd angrily remarked that Garmadon always let him down whenever he needed him and freed himself from the rubble with a powerful burst of Spinjitzu. Still stewing, Lloyd began to walk off, declaring his intention of finding the rest of his friends. Garmadon then called out to Lloyd and urged him to flee the city, branding Lloyd's quest as a waste of time. This greatly upset Lloyd who angrily replied that Garmadon only cared about himself.

At that moment, a police van drove up, interrupting the pair's argument. When Lloyd ran up to the driver to ask for help, he recoiled in shock when he saw that the driver was none other than Hounddog McBrag. To add further to Lloyd's shock, McBrag declared his intentions of arresting Lloyd in spite of the city's ongoing crisis. Incredulous, Lloyd asked McBrag if he was even aware of the ongoing situation, to which McBrag responded that he was, but his last orders were still to arrest Lloyd and the other ninja. At this moment, Garmadon stepped in, stating that he would handle McBrag. Realizing that his father intended to kill the police marshal, Lloyd tackled him just before he could fire a bolt of Destruction, causing Garmadon to misfire at a traffic sign instead. Lloyd and Garmadon then took the opportunity to flee into the sewers, though McBrag continued to chase after them. When the marshal found himself in trouble with a pair of crystallized Hypnobrai, Lloyd knocked them back with a blast of Energy, saving McBrag who sat in stunned silence by Lloyd's actions. Before parting ways, Lloyd told McBrag that orders were not always everything and expressed hope that McBrag could see that one day. He then descended further into the sewer tunnels, leaving McBrag behind to ponder his words.

Safe Haven[]

After wandering the sewers for some time, Lloyd and Garmadon arrived at the Serpentine library. While Garmadon insulted the library, Lloyd looked around for any signs of Skales or anyone else, hoping that they could assist in the battle that was to come. Unfortunately, all Lloyd was able to find was a note indicating that the library had closed due to the Crystal King's ongoing invasion. Garmadon then dismissed Lloyd's efforts as pointless and reminded him once again that the only way to defeat the Overlord was through Oni form. As with before, Lloyd once again resisted Garmadon's insistence and suggested that there could be another way to defeat the Overlord.

When Garmadon demanded to know why Lloyd refused to learn Oni form, Lloyd admitted that his greatest fear was becoming like his father - someone who had no compassion, no care, or concern for others. When Garmadon denied Lloyd's claim that he cared for no one, Lloyd exasperatedly demanded for him to prove it. When Garmadon produced the soda can holding Christofern, Lloyd grew even more frustrated and ranted how plants didn't count before storming off.

Compatible[]

Lloyd and Garmadon continued to explore the Sepertine's library when they received a transmission from Wu. Lloyd then reported on his discovery of the abandoned library and asked Nya if her powers were returning.

Distress Calls[]

Lloyd was startled by a rat in one of the bookshelves of the abandoned library and continued to walk about while his father discouragingly suggested that the Serpentine's assistance would not have mattered much anyway. When Lloyd argued with Garmadon over this statement, Garmadon replied dismissively that Lloyd's humanity was a weakness and that he once again needed to embrace his Oni side. Upset by this comment, Lloyd shot back that his humanity was not a sign of weakness and that Garmadon was incapable of having compassion for any other being as the Oni only sought to destroy. With a resigned sigh, Lloyd left a message for the Serpentine on a nearby chalkboard and agreed to leave the library, doubtful that anyone would even see his message. Before they left however, Lloyd heard a sudden rattling sound and became hopeful that there could have been survivors left in the sewers.

Traversing through the sewers, Lloyd began calling out for any survivors, though none appeared. After some time, he and Garmadon encountered three Hypnobrai that had been infected by the Crystal King's crystals. As they fought, Lloyd admitted that he was glad to have run into someone to fight, for he had a few frustrations to work out. After defeating two of the infected snakes, Lloyd looked on in horror as Garmadon charged the last one with a barrel and called out for his father not to destroy the infected snake. When Garmadon instead trapped him inside of the barrel and asked why Lloyd thought he was going to destroy the snake, Lloyd admitted that since his resurrection, destroying had been Garmadon's whole schtick, which the latter admitted as having once been true. Garmadon then explained that as of late, he was trying to have "complassion" for others by thinking of how it felt to be in the position of others and that under such circumstances, he wouldn't want to be destroyed either. As Garmadon sauntered off, Lloyd admitted with a shrug that Garmadon's imprisoning of the infected snake within a barrel was probably a moment of "complassion" and ran off to catch up with him.

After walking for some time, Lloyd took note of his father's glum expression and asked him what had been the matter. Although Garmadon refused to talk, Lloyd realized that he no longer carried his plant around and asked about it. Garmadon then resignedly admitted that he had left the plant behind in the library after Lloyd told him that one could not learn compassion and you either had it, or you didn't. Seeing the error of his ways, Lloyd admitted that his statement had been made in error, for Garmadon clearly carried about the plant. He then turned and urged for his father to follow him so that they could retrieve it.

An Issue of Trust[]

Lloyd and Garmadon emerged from the sewers in front of the newspaper warehouse and were reunited with the other ninja. As they approached, Lloyd waved to his friends and accepted a hug from Zane. The group were then greeted by Wu, who revealed to them that he had discovered a scroll detailing the ability of Dragon Form. After expressing surprise that Ronin had joined them for the final battle, Lloyd and the others gathered around Wu to learn about Dragon Form. Wu then admitted that while the scroll did not specifically state the method upon which Dragon Form could be achieved, the imagery depicted an individual jumping up, kicking back, and spinning around in the air. Lloyd and original four ninja then attempted to perform the art but were unsuccessful.

After more unsuccessful attempts at achieving Dragon Form, the ninja realized that the scroll was meant to be folded to reveal the secret of Dragon Form; specifically, the technique could only be performed during a specific event when the "allies united." Unfortunately, time had run out for any further discourse, for the entire Crystal army was on its way to the warehouse! Garmadon then decided that he would confront the Crystal King alone, but Lloyd intervened and stated that he would accompany his father for the final battle. Although Garmadon argued that Lloyd did not stand a chance against the Crystal King due to not yet mastering his Oni form, Lloyd reminded his father that he defeated the Crystal King once before without such powers. It was then agreed that Garmadon and Lloyd would confront the Crystal King atop his island while the others stayed behind to keep the Crystal army's attention on the ground. In preparation for the final conflict, Lloyd was provided Killow's mech suit to ascend to the Crystal Island.

As Lloyd suited up in Killow's mech, P.I.X.A.L. ran over the mech's capabilities and functions with him before hugging him and wishing him luck. Once P.I.X.A.L. left, Garmadon muttered under his breath that she didn't wish him luck and surmised it was because she didn't trust him. In response, Lloyd asked his father if he could blame her, but rather than answer, Garmadon asked if Lloyd trusted him. After initially refusing to answer the question, Lloyd conceded that he believed he could trust his father and flew off towards the Crystal Island. As the final battle begun on the ground below, Lloyd and Garmadon initiated their attack on the Crystal King. While Garmadon blasted him with bolts of Destruction, Lloyd cleaved apart one of the surrounding crystals and hurled it atop of the King. He then playfully called out towards his father for starting the battle before his arrival as the King launched his counterattack.

Dragon Form[]

As the Overlord underwent a transformation, Lloyd sought Harumi's help in defeating him, but Harumi believed only one side could win, claiming Lloyd was not strong enough. Despite Lloyd's objections, the situation escalated when the Overlord turned into the Crystal King Centaur. Lloyd, Garmadon, and the Overlord engaged in battle, leading to Lloyd having to abandon his mech after being pushed off the Crystal Island. The Overlord gained the advantage by electrocuting Lloyd and Garmadon, revealing his corruption of the Great Devourer and causing it to bite Garmadon, setting off a chain of events to facilitate his return. Harumi, realizing the Overlord's role in her parents' demise, attacked him, leading to a fierce battle until the Overlord attempted to crystallize Ninjago by tapping into the central crystal, claiming their failure.

Roots[]

Lloyd relayed the importance of halting the Overlord's use of the central crystal to Garmadon and Harumi, but their efforts were in vain. Garmadon sustained injuries from a crystal impact, prompting Lloyd to save him from imminent danger. Lloyd expressed concern for Garmadon's well-being upon witnessing his wounds, while Garmadon apologized for his errors and acknowledged his state. Despite Garmadon's insistence that Lloyd prioritize his own safety, Lloyd was resolute in rescuing him, only to be left devastated by Garmadon's apparent demise. The Overlord callously remarked that Lloyd need not mourn, as his own demise was imminent. Enraged, Lloyd assumed his Oni Form and launched an attack on the Overlord. However, upon catching sight of his reflection in the central crystal, Lloyd reverted to his normal state. The Overlord retaliated by striking Lloyd, causing him to teeter on the edge of the Crystal Island. As the Overlord used the central crystal once more, Lloyd plummeted just as Ninjago began to crystallize. Yet, when the ninja combined the Golden Weapon to thwart the Overlord's acquisition of the Powers of Creation, said powers struck Lloyd, transforming into their original form, the Golden Ultra Dragon.

Lloyd engaged in a fierce battle against the Overlord while riding the Golden Ultra Dragon, utilizing both Ice and Fire to attack. They chased each other around the Crystal Island, where Lloyd once again attacked the Overlord with Fire, causing him to crash onto the temple and shatter the central crystal. Concerned for Harumi's safety, Lloyd instructed her to take cover while the Golden Ultra Dragon immobilized the Overlord with its Elemental Powers. Lloyd then commanded the dragon to strike the Overlord with its tail, ultimately destroying his centaur form. Garmadon urgently warned Lloyd and Harumi to leave before the Crystal Island exploded. Lloyd was astonished to see Garmadon alive and well, questioning him about his faked death. Garmadon revealed that he did it to help Lloyd unlock his Oni Form, which Lloyd expressed frustration with, stating that it was not necessary to defeat the Overlord. Garmadon countered, suggesting that Lloyd's fear of his own reflection hindered the success of the Oni Form. Eventually, Lloyd, Garmadon, Harumi, and the ninja reunited as they all rode on the Golden Ultra Dragon. When the ninja greeted Lloyd, they cast suspicious glances at Harumi. Nevertheless, Lloyd reassured them that she had changed for the better.

A week later, Lloyd and the rest of the ninja were reconstructing the Monastery of Spinjitzu when they were pleasantly surprised by the arrival of the Resistance, who came forward to lend a helping hand. Amidst the rebuilding process, Lloyd exchanged a friendly wave with Harumi. In his search for a plank, Lloyd got assistance from Garmadon, who offered it as a gesture of support.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Master Wu assigned Lloyd a task to search for scrolls related to the Coalescence. Lloyd was perplexed by the concept and couldn't quite grasp its meaning. Lloyd casually placed the scrolls he had found next to Master Wu and asked if that was satisfactory. He then reassured him that he was available if he needed any further assistance. Master Wu addressed Lloyd as his student and nephew, hoping that Lloyd would excel as the future Master of the Monastery. He emphasized the importance of family and the role it plays in their journey. Lloyd, taken aback by Master Wu's words, couldn't fathom the idea of surpassing his uncle's wisdom and experience, considering that Master Wu had been in the Monastery for thousands of years. Suddenly, their conversation was interrupted by a violent quake. They hurriedly made their way to the courtyard, where the rest of the ninja were already gathered, their attention fixed on the Merge occurring. Lloyd, bewildered by the commotion, demanded an explanation for what was unfolding before them.[19]

Lloyd and the rest of the team used the Destiny's Bounty with the aim of rescuing as the citizens, making their way towards Ninjago City. When the Bounty went into the Merge, Wu mouthed to himself that he thought he could "pull it off," but that "it happened too soon," Lloyd couldn't hear due to the raging loud storm and holding onto one of the rails.[20] Amidst the chaos, Lloyd managed to save a young boy named Arin, ensuring his safety by returning him back to his neighborhood. Arin was concerned for his parents, who were trapped in the midst of the Merge. With unwavering determination, Lloyd assured Arin that their mission was to save everyone, including his parents. Unfortunately, the proximity to the Merge caused Lloyd to become separated from the rest of the ninja once the Merge was completed and had lost his mask. Lloyd found himself back at the Monastery of Spinjitzu. As he delved deeper into what the Merge unfolded, he discovered that all the realms converged into one. He believed that he was the only ninja to survive. Lloyd realized that the Merge was the very subject that Master Wu had been tirelessly researching. Unfortunately, the scrolls containing the knowledge had been destroyed, leaving Lloyd unable to decipher the true nature of his work. The only clue he had was that the Source Dragons were somehow involved in causing the Merge in the first place. Weeks later, he found the Destiny's Bounty. As Lloyd approached the Bounty, he saw a silhouette and instinctively launched an attack. However, upon closer inspection, he realized it was Kai. Feeling remorseful, Lloyd promptly apologized for his mistake. Kai, relieved that it was all a misunderstanding, expressed his joy at reuniting with Lloyd.[19]

The MergeQuakes started to materialize. Lloyd and Kai stumbled upon the realization that Elemental Powers had the ability to halt the destructive events.

Sealing the Cracks[]

After sealing their third MergeQuake that day, Kai and Lloyd talked about returning to the Monastery for a meal. At that moment, a fourth, stronger MergeQuake appeared, this one being capable of sucking things into it as well as expelling things. Determined to help the people who were being sucked into this fissure, Lloyd used his powers to generate an energy shield around the civilians as well as to move a tree that Kai had felled. Unfortunately, the MergeQuake was too strong and simply sucked in the tree that Lloyd hoped could serve as a bridge. Just then, the two ninja spotted a winged monkey regurgitating stones it had consumed, covering them with its sticky vomit. Upon seeing this, Lloyd realized that the coated stones could be stuck together to form a wall, which he and Kai hastily constructed to prevent the citizens from being sucked into the MergeQuake. Once they were secure, Lloyd used his powers to close the fissure. Afterwards, Lloyd returned to the Monastery to continue his research while Kai went on to hunt the remaining winged monkeys.

Going on his own[]

However, Lloyd and Kai soon came to the realization that if a significant number of MergeQuakes were to occur simultaneously, it would result in a catastrophic event known as the MergeQuake Storm, which would not only replicate the Merge but instead obliterate the realms entirely. Understanding the gravity of the situation, Lloyd and Kai understood that they couldn't face the problem alone and sought help. Lloyd decided to stay behind and ensure the safety of everyone, while Kai boarded the Bounty to explore the realms in search of a solution.[19]

The Merge: Part 1[]

Lloyd headed to the Crossroads and noticed Arin using Spinjitzu, mistakenly identifying him as one of the ninja.

Infiltrating a prison train, Lloyd unexpectedly encountered two Claw Hunters and successfully defeated them. As he emerged victorious, he came face to face with Arin and Sora. He confidently claimed ownership of the mask that Arin possessed.

The Merge: Part 2[]

While inquiring Arin and Sora about the mystery ninja, which was soon revealed by Sora as being the former, a hunter surprised Lloyd from behind and pushed him into the car. Now engaged in a fight, Lloyd used his sword to cut the two teens' restraints before knocking out the hunter. Arin then explained how he saw Lloyd during the Merge and recovered his mask, but Lloyd was repulsed by the mask's lack of maintenance. Before they escaped from the train, intending to jump off, Sora revealed that the hunters were holding a baby dragon hostage. The group then encountered Rapton and found themselves surrounded. When Arin took down the hunters behind them, Lloyd was surprised that he used Spinjitzu and learned from Sora that the former trained himself before she trying to show Lloyd that she had powers as well, but nothing happened. Learning she needed the dragon, Arin headed for the car containing him, which Lloyd misinterpreted as him leaving until Arin returned with the dragon. The dragon then gave Sora a boost of power, which she used to inadvertently turn the hunters’ swords into bombs before Lloyd and the teenagers jumped off the train. Lloyd soon assessed his surprise over Arin's ability to perform Spinjitzu and Sora's Technology power granted by the baby dragon. Sora then explained how they must return the baby dragon to his herd before watching him assemble some debris into a landmark from his home.

Lloyd then brought the teenagers to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, where they briefly searched the library for clues about the dragon's home, finally identifying it as being the Land of the Three Mountains. Acknowledging that it was far from the Mountains of Impossible Height, Lloyd took the group down to the hanger bay where an unfinished, second Destiny's Bounty lay in wait. After admitting he lacked the technical expertise to continue work on the ship's engine, Sora volunteered herself to work on it while Lloyd talked about his experiences in the years following the Merge. At the end of his story, Arin expressed his belief that fate had led Lloyd to be united with him and Sora, stating with excitement that Lloyd had to teach them as their master! Unfortunately, Lloyd sadly shook his head and informed Arin that he was not knowledgeable enough to be a master either and could not teach him or Sora.

With the new Bounty's engines up and running, Lloyd commandeered the ship through the skies as the group began their journey to the Land of the Three Mountains. When they finally began to near the end of their journey, the ship came under attack by Rapton and the Claws of Imperium, sending them spinning out of control. As Lloyd and the others braced for imminent impact against a mountainside, their collision was broken by the Matriarch of the Mountain Dragons, who towed the ship to safety before roughly dropping it atop a plateau. Slightly injured from the rough landing, Lloyd stepped off the Bounty, rubbing his head as the Matriarch accused Lloyd and the teenagers as being in league with the Claws of Imperium. In defense, Lloyd argued that the Claws had merely followed them to the Land of the Three Mountains and offered to prove to the Matriarch that he and the teenagers were not with them. In the ensuing battle, Lloyd kept a close eye on Arin as the two fought against the Claw Hunters to liberate the captured Mountain Dragons.

When Rapton and his forces turned their sights onto the Matriarch and subdued her, Lloyd rushed forward and single handedly knocked away the Hunters surrounding the Matriarch. He then asked the Matriarch for a spark of power before warning Rapton to stand down or face destruction. When Rapton laughed off Lloyd's warnings, the Matriarch empowered him with a spark of dragon energy, enabling Lloyd to summon a massive Spinjitzu tornado - one large enough to even engulf the Claws' airborne Hover chariots! With this boost of power, Lloyd was able to effortlessly defeat Rapton and his forces and free the Matriarch from her restraints, ending the battle as the hunters fled.

With the battle won, Lloyd turned back to the Matriarch who thanked Lloyd for his efforts in saving her herd. The Matriarch admitted that she too felt a connection with Lloyd and acknowledged that there may be more mysteries that no one could quite explain following the Merge. Throughout the conversation, Lloyd once again denied being a master, but acknowledged that he could at least serve as a teacher for Arin and Sora, noting that he could not save the world alone and would need their help to do so. In his parting words, Lloyd reflected on how the ninja had been a symbol of hope throughout Ninjago for years, though only now was he rediscovering a reason to hope again after the Merge. With that, Lloyd returned to the Bounty alongside Arin, Sora, and Riyu, the baby dragon having decided to continue journeying alongside Lloyd and the teenagers!

Crossroads Carnival[]

At the crack of dawn, Lloyd woke up his new students and informed them that it was time to begin their ninja training. When Sora protested the time, Lloyd replied that he was aware and that he was being generous by letting them "sleep in" for their first week. Ten minutes later, Lloyd and his new students were gathered in the courtyard, where Lloyd intended to show them the marvels of the Monastery's obstacle course. Unfortunately, almost everything began to go wrong, ranging from the obstacle course's gears being jammed to Lloyd having burned the tea he was to drink as a way to time his new students' training. Nevertheless, Lloyd explained how he was trained by the best - his uncle, Master Wu, and desired to emulate his teaching abilities. Lloyd had even grown a beard just like his uncle! When his students remarked that they could not see his beard, Lloyd ordered the two to begin training, even insisting that obstacle courses appeared more often in real life than one might expect.

By sundown, Lloyd admitted that without palatable tea to drink, he could not accurately assess his students' performances for the day but nevertheless urged them to get some rest for they would begin training again at dawn the next morning. Later that night, Lloyd discovered to his dismay that both of his students had sneaked off to the Crossroads Carnival. Despite initially muttering that he and the other ninja would never have done such a thing to Wu, Lloyd almost immediately corrected himself and admitted that they totally would have done the same thing. With that, Lloyd hastily made his way over to the Crossroads in search of his students.

Arriving at the Carnival, Lloyd attempted to ask several passerby if they had seen his missing students but was brushed off and bumped around, much to his chagrin. After being bumped into a nearby tent, Lloyd discovered that it housed a memorial to the Ninja, almost all of whom were still missing since the Merge. After speaking to a pair of children, Lloyd was surprised to learn that the memory of the Ninja had not faded and the people of the Merged Realms still retained fond memories of their heroes. With his hope restored, Lloyd continued to search for his students, eventually discovering a trail made from bits and pieces of Wu's meditation carpet - a sight that aggravated and frustrated him once more.

Following the trail of carpet scraps, Lloyd made his way to Dorama's theater and intervened just in time to briefly put a halt to a fight between his students and Dorama's puppet. Unfortunately the battle was far from over and the puppet rose to its feet once more to continue its rampage. As they fought, Arin hurled a gramophone at the puppet while somehow infusing the gramophone with Spinjitzu energy, resulting in a massive blow when the infused object struck the puppet's chest. Although he was amazed by what Arin had just done, there was no time for Lloyd to dwell on such matters. Recalling what Sora had said earlier that morning about stuff getting stuck in gears, Lloyd pulled out all the bits of meditation carpet he had collected and with the use of a nearby fan, sent them flying into the puppet's chest full of gears. With its mechanisms clogged, the puppet collapsed once more, ending the battle as Lloyd apprehended Dorama and contacted the authorities.

With the day saved, Lloyd and his students returned to Kreel's Junkyard to reunite Kreel with her minions that had been kidnapped by Dorama. Lloyd then apologized to his students and admitted that he had forgotten that training can be fun sometimes. As the four of them made their way to see the results of the pie-baking contest, Lloyd watched on as Arin was once again awarded second place. When Arin seemed crestfallen about his loss, Lloyd offered him some words of encouragement and suggested that Arin might win the contest at next year's carnival. He then agreed to Sora's suggestion for a snack tour but warned that their training would still resume the next day at the crack of dawn once more.

Beyond Madness[]

While observing Arin's progress through the obstacle course, Lloyd used Spinjitzu skills to rescue him after he fell. As Arin began to believe that he was the worst student ever, Lloyd countered with a story about how Jay destroyed the Monastery's south wing just by training there. He commended Arin for learning a version of Spinjitzu on his own but advised him to unlearn some of his self-taught techniques to achieve a more balanced approach. Lloyd and Sora discussed their elemental powers. Lloyd shared that it took him a while to realize his True Potential. Sora expressed confusion about Technology and whether or not she had an elemental power. Lloyd admitted that he was unfamiliar with Sora's element, but emphasized his lifelong study of Elemental Powers and the belief that true power lies within oneself. Sora, on the other hand, believed that the powers belonged to Riyu and that she merely borrowed them. Lloyd pointed out that during his encounter with Riyu's Matriarch, he was enhanced by dragon energy and that it amplified his own elemental powers, not those of the Matriarch. He then went on to explain that every Elemental Master was unique. Lloyd and the others then joined Riyu on top of the wall and were surprised to see the old Bounty hurtling toward them. The ship crashed, and the group inspected the damage. Lloyd observed scorch marks and questioned whether Kai was responsible. He then confirmed that the notes found belonged to Kai and that he was in the process of filling in a map. However, he only made it to one of the lands, which happened to be the direction the Bounty was coming from. Lloyd concluded that they must investigate further to uncover the truth behind Kai's disappearance. Upon boarding the new Bounty, Arin raised the question of whether Kai was in trouble, leading Lloyd to suggest that Kai may have sent the Bounty back on autopilot to find help. The team speculated that the seriousness of the situation must have prompted Kai to abandon the ship. However, Lloyd introduced the idea that it could be a trap. As Sora found Lloyd's notion amusing and questioned the likelihood of such a scenario, Lloyd responded by stating that it's occasionally true based on his past experiences.

Arriving in the Land of Madness, Lloyd and his students witnessed a battle taking place between the native Craglings and a pair of Earth Dragons. Believing that the dragons were innocent and facing attack by the rock monsters, Lloyd's students rushed out to aid them, leaving the Green Ninja too late to warn against rushing in without a plan first! After wondering if he and the other ninja were just as bad of students with Wu, and conceding that they were, Lloyd Spinjitzued down to assist his students in battle. When the Craglings were momentarily defeated enough to allow the dragons to escape, Lloyd's students celebrated, though he remained on guard in case of any further attack. And not soon after, a ball of water rushed through, knocking them all to their feet. Realization soon set in however and Lloyd knew that only one person could control water like that - his old friend, Nya, the Master of Water. Following their reunion, Lloyd sheepishly learned from Nya that the dragons were actually attacking the Cragling Village and Nya had been helping to defend them against the dragons. Nya then brought the group towards the village to meet King Crag-Nor.

As the ninja and their hosts sat down to eat an authentic Cragling feast of Cragling mud, Lloyd listened on as Nya explained how she found her way to the Land of Madness and joined Kai in defending the village until his seeming end. Shocked by the news, Lloyd gently placed a hand on Nya's shoulder in comfort as she admitted it was hard not to lose hope in these difficult times. Lloyd then introduced his students to Nya and explained their feats to her, noting how Sora was an elemental master and Arin managed to teach himself Spinjitzu. Unbeknownst to them however, Kai had survived his previous confrontation with the Earth Dragons and was in fact fleeing towards the Cragling village at this moment, with his screams of terror reaching Lloyd's ears. Realizing that Kai was still alive, the ninja rushed outside to gates to see the Master of Fire running towards them - with both very angry Earth Dragons in tow!

Nya quickly rushed into battle against the dragons, followed by Lloyd and Kai. Unfortunately since the three of them had neither seen one another, let alone fought together, for quite some time, their efforts were uncoordinated and easily routed. Nevertheless, Lloyd and the others were able to rediscover their footing and launched several attacks on the Earth Dragons up until Sora's powers failed in mid-air and her mech collapsed. Lloyd and Kai then leapt into the air, with Lloyd catching Sora while Kai caught his sister and returned safely to the ground. With the ninja momentarily defeated, the Earth Dragons turned their focus back to the sacred mud field and began gorging themselves without resistance. Riyu then subsequently used his dragon energy to overload the Earth Dragons, expelling the energy from them and returning it back to the energy field. Riyu's efforts though were met with suspicion at first from Nya and Kai, forcing Lloyd to intervene to prevent Kai from hurling a fireball at Riyu.

Following the battle, Lloyd spoke with Kai and Nya about his students, expressing lingering reservations about serving as their master. Nya though opined that the two were learning much from Lloyd and Kai expressed similar sentiments.

Writers of Destiny[]

Lloyd piloted the Bounty out from the Land of Madness. As they flew, Lloyd gave some some supporting information to Kai and Nya who were still getting to learn about Lloyd's new students and the MergeQuakes. Shortly thereafter, Lloyd pointed out a series floating islands with ivory towers, indicating to them all that they had arrived in the Cloud Kingdom. As they edged closer, a nearby tower began to crumble following a violent tremor. Lloyd worked to steer the Bounty while Kai and Nya hastily rescued a pair of monks who were trapped on the tower. The monks then explained that a beast was destroying everything, prompting Lloyd to order Kai and Nya to deal with the monster while he attempted to seal a nearby MergeQuake.

As the three older ninja began to work on their assigned tasks, Lloyd reacted with incredulity at first when Nya called out to him to stop sealing the MergeQuake. He relented however, when Nya explained that they still needed the rift to send the monster back where it came from. Agreeing with Nya's plan, Lloyd theorized that if the MergeQuake were sealed with the monster inside, then perhaps the creature would be banished in the process. Luckily, everything worked out exactly as planned! Lloyd then discussed the encounter with Kai and Nya before Kai decided to speak with a nearby group of Cloud Monks, believing that they were dying to honor the ninja as heroes.

After approaching the Cloud Monks, Lloyd and the others were greeted by Suetonius, the current Master Writer. In the ensuing conversation, Lloyd supported Kai's dismissive stance towards the Cloud Monks' belief that they were writers of destiny, noting that the monks tended to ignore circumstances that did not work as written. Nevertheless, Suetonius granted permission for the ninja to access the Cloud Kingdom archives to search for information pertaining to the Merge. Lloyd then ordered for Sora, Arin, and Riyu to stay behind and to call the older ninja out of the archives should anything go wrong. After entering the archives, Lloyd watched as Marcus explained the Scroll-Worms, remarking at first that they were great. However, when the worm revealed that Lloyd picked his nose and eats whatever he picked, a flustered Lloyd quickly changed his mind, branding the worms as being terrible while attempting to stop Kai's snickering. Shortly thereafter, the Scroll-Worm Nya had asked about MergeQuakes turned red when reciting information to them and attacked the ninja and Marcus, encasing all four in silk cocoons and suspending them from the ceiling of the archives.

Eventually, Lloyd was the first to be released from the cocoon by Arin and gasped for his student to look out for the other worms. Lloyd and Arin then fought off the remaining worms and freed the other three before joining the fight outside between Euphrasia, Sora, and three more Tentacled Beasts that had emerged out of a second MergeQuake. After sealing off the MergeQuake, Lloyd complimented Euphrasia and remarked that he liked her better than Morro, the previous Master of Wind. Afterwards, Lloyd prepared the Bounty for departure from Cloud Kingdom, saying his goodbyes to Nya who had decided to stay behind to continue researching for a way to stop the MergeQuakes. Kai then called out to Lloyd to get going, referring to him as "Boogers," eliciting an unamused look and a deadpan "stop it," from Lloyd.

Return to Imperium[]

Alongside Kai and his students, Lloyd attempted to stop Rapton and the Claw Hunters from capturing Jiro at Kreel's Junkyard. Entering the battle, Lloyd disarmed Rapton by throwing his dao at Rapton's Imperium Sword, pinning it to the ground. In the battle, Lloyd destroyed at least three Imperium Drones and knocked away a Claw Hunter with Spinjitzu. Despite momentarily defeating the hunters, Lloyd and the others were forced on the defensive when Rapton deployed a Photac, which the ninja soon discovered was indestructible due to its nature as a hard light construct. Thanks to this diversion, Rapton and the hunters were able to capture Jiro and escape.

Sometime later, Lloyd tried to talk Arin and Sora out of going to Imperium to destroy the Photacs, reminding both of them that they were still in training and emphasizing that they had no idea of who or what they might encounter in Imperium. When Arin insisted they could handle themselves, an unconvinced Lloyd reminded him that he had punched himself in the face during their earlier battle with the Claw Hunters. Nevertheless, Arin managed to convince Lloyd by quoting Master Wu's famous quote of "Ninja sharpens ninja," though Lloyd decided he would accompany his students to the city of Imperium. Lloyd then ordered Kai to stay behind to protect the Monastery and Ninjago from further MergeQuakes before moving to the relaxation room to discuss plans with his students.

Following Sora's belief that the Imperium Sewers lacked security, Lloyd and his students soon discovered that this assumption was very wrong. Lloyd managed to destroy the pursuing drones however as he and his students emerged in the Security Station. There, Sora created fake IDs for the three of them, with Lloyd requesting the name "Dyoll Donmagar" - an alias that Sora was not impressed by. When he glanced at the ID cards, Lloyd briefly expressed confusion that Sora used her real name on her ID. The three then raided some nearby lockers for clothing, with Lloyd also taking a large pan-shaped hat, remarking that Empress Beatrix must've approved such headgear. When they trio left the room however, they were almost immediately caught by an Imperium Guard for failing to wear shoulder pads on a weekday and were promptly escorted to the Public Shaming Platform. There, Lloyd fought back against the guards and caught a glimpse of fireballs blasting down the corner. Believing that Kai had disobeyed orders and got himself captured, Lloyd stormed over to the holding cells in frustration and opened up the cell from which the fireballs were coming. As he started to give a stern lecture, Lloyd paused in his tracks as he realized the fireball shooting individual imprisoned in the cell was not Kai.

Mindless Beasts[]

Lloyd found himself evading Wyldfyre's relentless attacks, attempting to clarify that he was merely in disguise. However, Wyldfyre remained unconvinced and persisted with her assault. Lloyd then accused Wyldfyre of being an Elemental Master of Fire, having witnessed her projecting flames. Wyldfyre was perplexed by Lloyd's accusation and more concerned about her family's abduction. Lloyd was taken aback to learn of Wyldfyre's plight and vehemently denied any association with Imperium. Despite their initial disagreement, they joined forces to combat the Imperium Guards. Wyldfyre was surprised that Lloyd saved her and started believing that they are on the same side. They both continued their fight against the guards.

As he and Wyldfyre successfully defeated the guards, Lloyd suggested escaping through the sewers, but Wyldfyre insisted on saving her family. They eventually come across the Imperium Prison, and Wyldfyre identified one as the location of her family. However, she failed to open the door, and Lloyd shot Energy at the control panel, successfully opening the door. Inside the cell was a dragon named Heatwave, who Wyldfyre greeted happily. As Lloyd thought Heatwave was just Wyldfyre's pet, Wyldfyre explained to him that Heatwave is her family and that she was raised by him in the Wyldness. Lloyd was surprised but acknowledged that Wyldfyre being raised by a dragon in the Wyldness was the reason for her agression.

I Will Be the Danger[]

Having now released all of Imperium's captured dragons, Lloyd surveyed his surroundings as a large force of Imperium Guards confronted him and his allies. While Wyldfyre was all to eager to fight, Lloyd on the other hand expressed caution and offered to use his fake ID to defuse the situation. Unfortunately, Wyldfyre dismissed Lloyd's concerns and suggestion and rushed into battle with the guards, leaving Lloyd to find another way out. As luck would have it, one of the guards was thrown across the room into the console Lloyd was trying to use, smashing it and opening the roof of the Imperium Prison. Lloyd then hopped onto the Earth Dragon as they made their escape into the City of Imperium. With the dragons now running about in search of a way out, Lloyd noted that since the city's electro barrier was still intact, the only way out would be through the main gates.

As the procession continued, Lloyd attempted in vain to convince Wyldfyre to organize the dragons, pointing out that they were causing too much collateral damage and putting civilian lives in danger. While stating this, Lloyd destroyed several pieces of falling debris before they could fall on citizens on the ground. Unfortunately Wyldfyre was not receptive to this idea either, leaving Lloyd with no further options. By the time the group reached the main gates, Arin had regrouped with Lloyd and the dragons but they were now confronted by the Claws of Imperium who were now equipped with multiple indestructible Photacs. Horrified by the sight, Lloyd could only question Sora's true allegiance under his breath. Shortly thereafter, Wyldfyre declared that they would fight against the Claws, initiating an all-out battle on the palace grounds. Sora and Zanth soon joined the battle, regrouping with Lloyd and Arin. Sora revealed that she had a plan to stop the Photacs, but it required the assistance of Riyu who was unfortunately now missing. With a sigh, Lloyd ordered Sora and Arin to find Riyu while he and Wyldfyre would assist the dragons in fighting the Claws and their Photacs for as long as possible.

The Calm Inside[]

Lloyd continued fighting against the Claws of Imperium but grew increasingly stressed as the battle raged on without any success from Sora and Arin on their task. Eventually the stress of the situation was nearly too overwhelming for the Green Ninja, but he managed to regain control over himself after recalling Wu's words about discovering the calm inside. Lloyd then rallied the dragons into attacking the Imperium Palace to draw out Beatrix and Ras so that Sora and Arin could save Riyu. As the battle continued, Lloyd and all the other participants watched as the Monastery of Imperium rose into the city streets, with Lloyd urging his allies to be prepared for whatever happened next.

The Battle of the Second Monastery[]

Lloyd was shocked to see Kai, Nya, and Zane emerge from the Monastery of Imperium. There was, however, no time to explain or even to figure out what was going on for there was still an ongoing battle to win! While dodging blasts and fighting back the Claws of Imperium, Lloyd quickly explained the situation to his friends while asking what exactly was the Monastery of Imperium. After nearly being trampled by a Photac, Nya called out to Lloyd, asking if they had any weaknesses to exploit, leaving Lloyd to admit that the Photacs were actually indestructible and right now, all they could do was buy time for Arin and Sora to execute their plan.

As the battle continued, Zane informed his allies that retreat was their only viable option. At first, Lloyd responded with incredulity, pointing out that they were right in the middle of Imperium, so where exactly could they retreat to? Zane responded by suggesting the Monastery of Imperium and Lloyd immediately agreed to Zane's suggestion. Once the ninja and the dragons were safely barricaded behind the monastery's steel gates, Lloyd attempted again in vain to reach Sora and Arin over comms but received no answer. The ninja then discussed using the monastery's Portal gate to escape from Imperium, but Zane cautioned that more power was required for the gate to transport such a large number of dragons. Fortunately, the Ice Ninja had also detected a large, yet unknown, energy source beneath the monastery which Lloyd surmised must have been a large battery or something similar. Lloyd then inspected the monastery floor, reasoning that if it were anything like the Monastery of Spinjitzu, then there would surely be a hidden room switch somewhere. Before he could even finish his sentence, Lloyd inadvertently activated a switch disguised as a floor tile and immediately fell down a once hidden flight of stairs as it opened up.

Lloyd called out to the others to assure them he was okay and called for Zane to follow. The two then crawled through the Imperium sewers until they finally reached a massive room containing a strange, glass sphere. Within the sphere, Lloyd was able to make out the shape of a dragon, though this dragon was far larger than any he had previously been familiar with. Approaching the sphere to free the imprisoned dragon, Lloyd and Zane were stunned when it began to speak with the through telepathy, demanding for the pair not to free him. The dragon then explained his existence as a Source Dragon and cautioned that his release could destabilize the entire existence of the Merged Lands. Nevertheless, the Source Dragon agreed to transfer some of his energy to Lloyd, anointing him as a Conduit, so that Lloyd could power the portal gate to save the other dragons. When the dragon transferred his energy over to Lloyd, the Green Ninja immediately felt a strange rush and experienced a series of Visions, possibly portending to the future. Now charged up with energy, Lloyd flew back up to the Monastery of Imperium and powered up its gate before collapsing.

When Lloyd awoke, he found himself back in his room at the Monastery of Spinjitzu. Confused as to what had happened and where everyone was, Lloyd wandered out into the courtyard where he saw Sora training on her own. Sora then revealed to Lloyd that he had been asleep for a few days now as the other ninja approached him. Although the others were excited to see their friend awake again, Lloyd gave his attention first to Arin who seemed rather downtrodden. Arin confessed to Lloyd his fear that since now most of the old ninja had rejoined the team, there would no longer be a need for him or Sora to train as new ninja anymore. In response, Lloyd reassured Arin that he would one day be a greater ninja than any of them were and that although Arin had lost his parents in the merge, he had found himself a new family here with the ninja and the other students. Lloyd then returned Arin the old green ninja hood that the teenager had found years prior during the Merge.

The Temple of the Dragon Cores[]

Lloyd and the other ninja responded to a MergeQuake in the Crossroads. Riding atop a Mountain Dragon with Arin, Lloyd steered the dragon for Arin to stop a falling sign before blasting the MergeQuake to seal it. Following the success of this mission, the ninja returned to the Monastery where Lloyd began working on all the housekeeping chores, including tidying the picture frames on the walls, cleaning up all the trash, making repairs to the monastery, etc. To help alleviate his workload, Lloyd asked Kai to train Wyldfyre due to them having similar powers, but in the process Lloyd also repeatedly dismissed Zane's constant requests to speak and insisted to Arin and Sora that since Wu could handle the upkeep of the entire monastery on his own, so could Lloyd. Eventually however, it became increasingly clear to everyone that Lloyd was overwhelmed. A few days later, after breaking up a fight between Kai and Wyldfyre, a very annoyed Zane stepped in and demanded for everyone to follow him to the hanger bay, where he showed everyone the data he had been analyzing about the MergeQuakes. At first Lloyd was annoyed that Zane had dragged him away from watering the plants just to tell him what he already knew, but Zane soon revealed that while everyone knew the MergeQuakes were getting worse, they hadall woefully underestimated the severity of the problem.

The next day, following research conducted by Nya, the ninja set out in search for the Temple of the Dragon Cores, discovering it within the World Forest. Lloyd briefly commented on the size of the trees, remarking that they were the size of skyscrapers. After arriving at the temple, the ninja were faced with a perplexing puzzle they would have to solve to enter the temple. After a poor showing by Kai at opening the doors, Zane began to analyze the levers and runes, running together every potential combination.
